entities.summary: Kōminka Movement and War, a transformative movement in Taiwan (1937–1945). Emerged from Kodama and Pacification and Colonial Development. Catalyzed February 28 Incident — KMT troops massacre an estimated 18,000–28,000 Taiwanese.
